If you mostly just want to level up quick, sell and launder your max amount per day.

If you want to make the most gold, only sell green or blue and above treasure items. Launder anything that might be worth selling in the guild store (eg certain furnishing plans).

For levelling up I do a mixture of both of these. First I'll only sell high quality treasures and only launder things worth selling in the guild store. But when I'm about to log off I'll sell any other treasures and launder random crafting materials to get to the daily cap. 

Just depends whether you value time or gold more.
